column1: # [voice37] Every voice file bundled in the release jar (gradlew -PbundleVoice=true build): group, file, bytes, SHA-256, licence, source,
# and optionally a mirror of the very same file (tried only if the source fails; the SHA-256 decides either way).
# The build downloads each from its pinned source, checks it, and packs it under assets/mc_assistant/voicepack/<group>/; the mod unpacks
# and checks them on first use. PaVoiceDeliveryTest keeps this list the same as PaKokoro.PARTS, PaExpressive.PARTS and PaVosk.PARTS.
